summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Knowledge Mapping, Taxonomy, and Ontology Design. Master essential skills to elevate your data management strategies.
lede: Knowledge management taxonomy and classification structure business information so teams can find and reuse relevant knowledge. For professionals who organize records, content, or business knowledge, this course covers mapping knowledge domains, designing taxonomies and controlled vocabularies, and creating metadata and simple business ontologies. It also explores aligning these structures with workflows and search needs.
audienceIntro: This training is ideal for professionals responsible for organizing, managing, and enabling access to knowledge, including:
modules: Aligning Knowledge Models with Business Processes
Avoiding Knowledge Mapping Biases and Pitfalls
